title: Canadian special elections indicate voters backing Carney’s stand against Trump
summary_full: Prime Minister Mark Carney had vowed to match U.S. tariffs "dollar for dollar," unlike other longtime U.S. partners who had raced to cut deals when faced with tariff threats.
